question: How many sales orders are there in total?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: What is the total revenue (the sum of TotalDue) across all sales orders?
referenceSql: SELECT SUM(TotalDue) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: How many sales orders are in my territory?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: What is the average order total (TotalDue) of my orders?
referenceSql: SELECT AVG(TotalDue) AS AverageOrder FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: How many products have a list price above 1000?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ProductCount FROM Production.Product WHERE ListPrice > 1000

question: How many employees are currently active?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActiveEmployees FROM HumanResources.Employee WHERE CurrentFlag = 1

question: List the name and credit rating of every vendor with credit rating 1.
referenceSql: SELECT Name, CreditRating FROM Purchasing.Vendor WHERE CreditRating = 1

question: How many sales orders were placed online?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OnlineOrders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE OnlineOrderFlag = 1

question: What is the highest list price of any product?
referenceSql: SELECT MAX(ListPrice) AS HighestListPrice FROM Production.Product

question: How many sales territories are there in each territory group? Show the group and the count.
referenceSql: SELECT [Group], COUNT(*) AS Territories FROM Sales.SalesTerritory GROUP BY [Group]

question: How many departments are there in each department group? Show the group name and the count.
referenceSql: SELECT GroupName, COUNT(*) AS Departments FROM HumanResources.Department GROUP BY GroupName

question: What is the total freight charged on all sales orders?
referenceSql: SELECT SUM(Freight) AS TotalFreight FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: How many different customers have placed an order in my territory?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS Customers FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: How many products are there of each color? Leave out products that have no color.
referenceSql: SELECT Color, COUNT(*) AS Products FROM Production.Product WHERE Color IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Color

question: What is the average standard cost of the products that have a standard cost above zero?
referenceSql: SELECT AVG(StandardCost) AS AverageCost FROM Production.Product WHERE StandardCost > 0

question: How many customers are linked to a store?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS StoreCustomers FROM Sales.Customer WHERE StoreID IS NOT NULL

question: What is the total tax amount (TaxAmt) on my orders?
referenceSql: SELECT SUM(TaxAmt) AS TotalTax FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader

question: How many credit cards are on file for each card type? Show the card type and the count.
referenceSql: SELECT CardType, COUNT(*) AS Cards FROM Sales.CreditCard GROUP BY CardType

question: How many products are there in each product category? Show the category name and the count. Only count products that belong to a subcategory.
referenceSql: SELECT c.Name AS Category, COUNT(*) AS Products FROM Production.Product p JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY c.Name

question: What is the total sales revenue (the sum of LineTotal on the order lines) per product category? Show the category name and the total.
referenceSql: SELECT c.Name AS Category, SUM(d.LineTotal) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail d JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY c.Name

question: For each sales territory, how many sales orders were placed? Show the territory name and the order count.
referenceSql: SELECT t.Name AS Territory, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.SalesTerritory t ON t.TerritoryID = h.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.Name

question: Who are the 5 salespeople with the highest SalesYTD? Show first name, last name and SalesYTD, highest first.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 p.FirstName, p.LastName, sp.SalesYTD FROM Sales.SalesPerson sp JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID = sp.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY sp.SalesYTD DESC

question: What is the total order value (TotalDue) per country region code? Show the country region code and the total.
referenceSql: SELECT t.CountryRegionCode, SUM(h.TotalDue) AS Total FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.SalesTerritory t ON t.TerritoryID = h.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.CountryRegionCode

question: Which 5 vendors have the largest total purchase order value (TotalDue)? Show the vendor name and the total.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 v.Name AS Vendor, SUM(po.TotalDue) AS Total FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderHeader po JOIN Purchasing.Vendor v ON v.BusinessEntityID = po.VendorID GROUP BY v.Name ORDER BY SUM(po.TotalDue) DESC

question: What are the 5 best-selling products by total quantity sold in my territory? Show the product name and the total quantity.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 p.Name AS Product, SUM(d.OrderQty) AS Quantity FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail d JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY SUM(d.OrderQty) DESC

question: What is the total order value (TotalDue) per salesperson, for orders that have a salesperson? Show the salesperson's last name and the total, for the 10 highest totals, highest first.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 10 p.LastName, SUM(h.TotalDue) AS Total FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.SalesPerson sp ON sp.BusinessEntityID = h.SalesPersonID JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID = sp.BusinessEntityID GROUP BY p.LastName ORDER BY SUM(h.TotalDue) DESC

question: How much revenue (the sum of LineTotal on the order lines) did my territory bring in per product category? Show the category name and the total.
referenceSql: SELECT c.Name AS Category, SUM(d.LineTotal) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail d JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY c.Name

question: How many order lines were sold with a special offer other than the 'No Discount' offer?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS DiscountedLines FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail d JOIN Sales.SpecialOffer o ON o.SpecialOfferID = d.SpecialOfferID WHERE o.Description <> 'No Discount'

question: What is the average list price per product subcategory? Show the subcategory name and the average list price. Only include subcategories that have products.
referenceSql: SELECT s.Name AS Subcategory, AVG(p.ListPrice) AS AveragePrice FROM Production.Product p JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID GROUP BY s.Name

question: For each sales reason, how many sales orders cite it? Show the reason name and the order count.
referenceSql: SELECT r.Name AS Reason, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason hr JOIN Sales.SalesReason r ON r.SalesReasonID = hr.SalesReasonID GROUP BY r.Name

question: How many sales orders were placed in each year? Show the year and the count.
referenceSql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS OrderYear, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate)

question: What is the total revenue (the sum of TotalDue) of the sales orders placed in 2013?
referenceSql: SELECT SUM(TotalDue) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE OrderDate >= '2013-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2014-01-01'

question: Which month of 2013 had the most orders in my territory? Show the month number and the order count.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 1 MONTH(OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE OrderDate >= '2013-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2014-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: What is the running total of order value (TotalDue) by month for 2012? Show the month number, that month's total and the cumulative total up to and including that month, in month order.
referenceSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT MONTH(OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, SUM(TotalDue) AS MonthTotal FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE OrderDate >= '2012-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate)) SELECT OrderMonth, MonthTotal, SUM(MonthTotal) OVER (ORDER BY OrderMonth) AS RunningTotal FROM monthly ORDER BY OrderMonth

question: For each year, which product category had the highest revenue (the sum of LineTotal on the order lines)? Show the year, the category name and its revenue.
referenceSql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS OrderYear, c.Name AS Category, SUM(d.LineTotal) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail d ON d.SalesOrderID = h.SalesOrderID JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate), c.Name), ranked AS (SELECT OrderYear, Category, Revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY OrderYear ORDER BY Revenue DESC) AS Position FROM yearly) SELECT OrderYear, Category, Revenue FROM ranked WHERE Position = 1

question: How many sales orders were placed in the last quarter of 2013 (October to December)?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE OrderDate >= '2013-10-01' AND OrderDate < '2014-01-01'

question: How many orders in my territory have an order total (TotalDue) above the average order total of my territory?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersAboveAverage FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE TotalDue > (SELECT AVG(TotalDue) FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader)

question: Which products have more than 2 records in their standard cost history? Show the product ID and the number of records.
referenceSql: SELECT ProductID, COUNT(*) AS CostRecords FROM Production.ProductCostHistory GROUP BY ProductID HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

question: Which job titles are held by more than 5 current employees (CurrentFlag = 1)? Show the job title and the number of employees.
referenceSql: SELECT JobTitle, COUNT(*) AS Employees FROM HumanResources.Employee WHERE CurrentFlag = 1 GROUP BY JobTitle HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: Which 5 stores in my territory placed the most sales orders? Show the store name and the order count, highest first. Only count orders of store customers.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 st.Name AS Store, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.Customer c ON c.CustomerID = h.CustomerID JOIN Sales.Store st ON st.BusinessEntityID = c.StoreID GROUP BY st.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: How many different orders in my territory include at least one product from the 'Bikes' product category?
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.SalesOrderID) AS BikeOrders FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail d ON d.SalesOrderID = h.SalesOrderID JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID WHERE c.Name = 'Bikes'

question: Who are the 5 individual customers (not stores) in my territory with the highest total order value (TotalDue)? Show first name, last name and the total, highest first.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 p.FirstName, p.LastName, SUM(h.TotalDue) AS Total FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.Customer c ON c.CustomerID = h.CustomerID JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID = c.PersonID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, p.FirstName, p.LastName ORDER BY SUM(h.TotalDue) DESC

question: How many units are in stock per product category (the sum of Quantity in the product inventory, over all locations)? Show the category name and the quantity. Only count products that belong to a subcategory.
referenceSql: SELECT c.Name AS Category, SUM(i.Quantity) AS UnitsInStock FROM Production.ProductInventory i JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = i.ProductID JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID GROUP BY c.Name

question: Which 5 products have the largest total rejected quantity (RejectedQty) on purchase order lines? Show the product name and the total rejected quantity, highest first.
referenceSql: SELECT TOP 5 p.Name AS Product, SUM(d.RejectedQty) AS Rejected FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderDetail d JOIN Production.Product p ON p.ProductID = d.ProductID GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY SUM(d.RejectedQty) DESC

question: For each salesperson, what is their most recent sales quota in the quota history? Show the salesperson's last name, the quota date and the quota amount (SalesQuota).
referenceSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT BusinessEntityID, QuotaDate, SalesQuota, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BusinessEntityID ORDER BY QuotaDate DESC) AS Position FROM Sales.SalesPersonQuotaHistory) SELECT p.LastName, l.QuotaDate, l.SalesQuota FROM latest l JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID = l.BusinessEntityID WHERE l.Position = 1

question: What is the average current hourly pay rate per job title? Use each employee's most recent rate (the latest RateChangeDate) in the pay history. Show the job title and the average rate.
referenceSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT BusinessEntityID, Rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BusinessEntityID ORDER BY RateChangeDate DESC) AS Position FROM HumanResources.EmployeePayHistory) SELECT e.JobTitle, AVG(l.Rate) AS AverageLatestRate FROM HumanResources.Employee e JOIN latest l ON l.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID WHERE l.Position = 1 GROUP BY e.JobTitle

question: How many customers placed their first-ever sales order in each year? Show the year and the number of customers.
referenceSql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT CustomerID, MIN(OrderDate) AS FirstOrder FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT YEAR(FirstOrder) AS FirstOrderYear, COUNT(*) AS NewCustomers FROM firsts GROUP BY YEAR(FirstOrder)

question: How many employees were hired in each year, and how many have been hired in total up to and including that year? Show the year, that year's hires and the cumulative total, in year order. Count every row of the employee table, including employees who are no longer current.
referenceSql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT YEAR(HireDate) AS HireYear, COUNT(*) AS Hires FROM HumanResources.Employee GROUP BY YEAR(HireDate)) SELECT HireYear, Hires, SUM(Hires) OVER (ORDER BY HireYear) AS CumulativeHires FROM yearly ORDER BY HireYear
